newsitem.title: FRANCE: Only Russian debt traded in Paris is Tsarist-era.
newsitem.headline: Only Russian debt traded in Paris is Tsarist-era.

text.p: The only Russian debt traded on the Paris bourse is Tsarist-era bonds issued before the 1917 Communist revolution, an official at the SBF French stockmarkets' association said on Monday.
The SBF earlier on Monday said it was suspending trading in all Russian debt due to rumours in the French media.

"Because of rumours that have been relayed by various information services, relative to Russian loans, the listing of these is provisionally suspended from today, November 25, 1996," the SBF said in a statement.

Russia last Thursday returned to the international financial markets with a $1.0 billion five-year Eurobond issue and there have been rumours in Paris that Russia would make some kind of compensation payment to the holders of the old bonds.
Russia defaulted on its loans since the Communist took power in 1917. Before that there had been close financial ties between Russia and France.
